fusions.name: Snarling Lunge
fusions.desc: Snaps through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Pack-Leader's Bite
fusions.desc: Bites the target for 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. When it lands, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Lick the Wounds
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, rising 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Faithful Cub
fusions.desc: A bonded cub follows you and bites enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.3 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
